title: Package 10 retryable intake preserved-input remediation

finding.trigger: submit the timeout URL, open the retryable FAILED intake, then expand Preserved Input
finding.expected: durable original URL and any available corrected input
finding.cause: preservedInput is derived only from parsedFields, which is empty when retrieval fails before parsing

forbidden_paths: Package 10 canonical HTML and archived design evidence
legacy or retired Operator visual implementations
acceptance: Pre-parse retryable failure exposes durable originalUrl instead of an empty object
Canonical URL, HeatZone context and corrected field values are preserved when present
No business value or browser-only fixture state is fabricated
Sensitive keys remain redacted by purpose binding
Reload and retry consume the durable API-backed intake record
Focused and full web unit, web/root typecheck, build and diff checks pass
No ODP-P10-CAN-003-R3A E2E spec is changed
R3A reruns its blocked retry test after the exact merged SHA is available

conflicts.rule: R3A owns E2E assertions; R3D owns preserved-input product code; no overlap
R3C owns Governance files; R3D owns Network intake recovery files; no overlap
